messages:
ashley: heads-up — taking over late shift. quick snapshot of gpu pools at 21:06 PT: overall util ~78%, burst headroom ~15% on eu-west. leaving a note for any midday spikes.

ashley: small FYI, /metrics shows a handful of customers with queued requests on pool-g. not critical but might eat the burst window if more jobs land.

mike: thanks. do you have runbook link? I can watch the queue while i finish tests.

ashley: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-gpu-pools (see "queue surge" section). short checklist: check pool-g queue length, bump burst if below 10% available, watch for preempt events.

jenna: pinging to ask — any ongoing batch jobs from partner-x? they ran a big job earlier and i saw retries.

ashley: partner-x had a 2h batch at 19:00, looks finished. i see 3 small retries (id: r-993f). not ramping.

sam: oncall-bot reports a scheduled deploy at 22:00 that may temporarily increase seq lengths. keep an eye on latency around that time. :eyes:

oncall-bot: scheduled-deploy | service: model-router | window: 22:00-22:10 PT | impact: short per-request latency bumps expected

priya: noted. i'll be on standby for the deploy. if latency + queue start to rise together, consider throttling non-critical customers (policy: degrade to small-model-variant).

ashley: good call. current policy thresholds: queue_len > 60 && p50_latency > 250ms => trigger degrade.

mike: can someone paste current pool-g token quota? i want to check headroom for today.

ashley: quick snapshot (21:10):
```
pool-g: total_tokens_quota=1.2T used_today=640B remaining=560B burst_remaining=180B
pool-f: total_tokens_quota=900B used_today=820B remaining=80B burst_remaining=20B
```

jenna: pool-f is a little tight, could see throttles if a single customer spikes. any customers pinned to pool-f that we should warn?

ashley: two heavy customers pinned: analytics-inc, maplytics. i've DM'd their SEs to ask they delay big exports until morning.

sam: if pool-f spikes, is automatic routing to pool-g enabled? last I recall there was a soft-failover but only for unpinned customers.

ashley: correct — soft-failover only for flexible routing customers. pinned ones will get throttled.

priya: plan: i'll monitor deploy window. mike and jenna, if you see queue_len cross 50, please escalate here and i'll trigger temporary burst increase for pool-f (5-10%) while we coordinate with SEs.

mike: ack. i'll watch metrics and set a small alert for queue_len >= 50 on pool-f.

jenna: ack — i'll keep an eye on pinned customers and be ready to throttle exports.

ashley: thanks team. i'll drop another status at 22:05 post-deploy. for now leaving coverage to priya for deploy, mike/jenna for queues. :thumbsup:
